title: ProBuild Membership Administration Limits
content:
A Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards membership may let authorized purchasers buy under it. Two limits, fixed per tier, apply: the largest number of authorized purchasers on the membership, and the largest number of additions or removals of authorized purchasers in one calendar month.

| Tier | Most authorized purchasers on the membership | Most additions or removals per calendar month |
|---|---|---|
| ProBuild Member | 3 | 2 |
| ProBuild Bronze | 5 | 3 |
| ProBuild Silver | 10 | 5 |
| ProBuild Gold | 25 | 10 |
| ProBuild Platinum | 50 | 20 |
| ProBuild Platinum Elite | 100 | 40 |

## Points of reading

- The monthly figure counts additions and removals together: at ProBuild Bronze, two additions and one removal in the same calendar month use the whole monthly figure of 3.
- Hypothetical: a ProBuild Silver membership with 10 authorized purchasers is at its limit of 10.
